t: You're at the Courtauld Gallery, an art museum inside Somerset House on the Strand. Sir William Chambers, the Swedish-born architect who also designed the Gold State Coach and the pagoda at Kew, designed the building. The gallery holds the collection of the Samuel Courtauld Trust and is part of the Courtauld Institute of Art. That institute was founded in 1932 by the industrialist and collector Samuel Courtauld, together with Lord Lee of Fareham and the art historian Sir Robert Witt. Courtauld gave his collection to it.
